passages.english: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.

lines.text: Many false prophets have gone out into the world — led astray by the spirit of the antichrist.
So, beloved, do not believe every spirit — every voice that claims to speak for God.
Instead, test the spirits.
See whether the spirits are truly from God.

passages.english: By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God, and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.

lines.text: Every spirit that confesses Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God.
This is how you know the Spirit of God.
But every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God.
This denying spirit is the spirit of the antichrist.
You have heard that the antichrist is coming.
And now the antichrist's spirit is already in the world.

passages.english: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.

lines.text: You, dear children, belong to God.
God himself lives in you.
The devil is in the world.
But God is greater than the devil.
So you have overcome the false prophets.

passages.english: They are of the world. That is why they speak from the world’s perspective, and the world listens to them.

lines.text: False prophets belong to the world.
So false prophets speak from the world's point of view.
And the world listens to false prophets.

passages.english: We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. That is how we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.

lines.text: Apostles like John are from God.
Whoever knows God listens to the apostles.
But whoever is not from God does not listen to the apostles.
This is how we can recognize the Spirit of truth.
And this is how we can recognize the spirit of deception.

passages.english: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

lines.text: Beloved, let us love one another.
For love comes from God.
Everyone who loves has been born of God.
And everyone who loves knows God.

passages.english: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

lines.text: God is love.
So whoever does not love does not know God, who is love.

passages.english: This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.

lines.text: God sent His one and only Son into the world.
God did this so that we might live through His Son.
This is how God revealed His love among us.

passages.english: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

lines.text: Real love did not begin with us loving God.
Real love began with God loving us.
So God sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins — Jesus paid for our sins.

passages.english: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

lines.text: Beloved, God loved us so much.
So we also ought to love one another.

passages.english: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.

lines.text: No one has ever seen God.
But suppose we love one another.
Then God remains in us.
And God's love is made complete in us.

passages.english: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.

lines.text: God has given us His Spirit.
By this we know that we remain in God.
And God remains in us.

passages.english: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.

lines.text: Suppose someone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God.
Then God remains in that person.
And that person remains in God.

passages.english: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world.

lines.text: We eyewitnesses have seen Jesus and testify about Him.
The Father has sent His Son, Jesus.
Jesus is the Savior of the world.

passages.english: And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.

lines.text: We have come to know and believe the love God has for us.
God is love.
Whoever remains in love remains in God.
And God remains in that person.

passages.english: In this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like Him.

lines.text: In this way, love has been made complete among us.
In this world we are like Jesus — we love as He loves.
So we can have confidence on the day of judgment.

passages.english: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.

lines.text: Fear involves punishment.
But complete love drives out fear.
So there is no fear in love.
The one who fears has not yet been made complete in love.

passages.english: We love because He first loved us.

lines.text: God first loved us.
So we love.

passages.english: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.

lines.text: Suppose someone does not love their visible brother or sister, whom they have seen.
Then they cannot love the invisible God, whom they have not seen.
So a person may say, 'I love God.'
But that person hates their brother or sister.
That person is a liar.

passages.english: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.

lines.text: And God has given us this commandment:
Whoever loves God must also love every brother and sister.
